{{Quote|Now, assemble your warriors and your medic at the edge of town and go find Attichitcuk.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Chewbacca|audio=TU4-WNARN-L46.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] '''rescued''' their [[Wookiee Chieftain|chieftain]], [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], from the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], the Wookiees were in competition with the Trade Federation for possession of Alaris Prime, and Attichitcuk had been injured and left for [[Death/Legends|dead]] in an [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|encounter]] with enemy [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s.

Guided by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Attichitcuk's son, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], led a party of [[bowcaster trooper]]s from a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]] to save his [[Parent/Legends|father]], destroying [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[DRN-38]] along the way. After locating and reviving Attichitcuk, the party returned to the base and destroyed yet more [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. Chewbacca then became leader of the colonists while his [[Gender/Legends|father]] recovered.

==Prelude==
===Preparations for war===
{{Quote|We are in no position to challenge the Trade Federation army. For now, we must concentrate on defending ourselves if they challenge us.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiee colonists|audio=TU4-WNARN-L09.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Alaris_Prime_colonists.png|thumb|left|200px|Chewbacca his fellow Wookiees prepare to face the Trade Federation on Alaris Prime.]]
Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> having been [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|granted]] the colonial rights to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] led a [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonization force]] consisting of other members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] to settle their new home. After arriving on Alaris Prime, a group of Wookiee [[bowcaster trooper]]s led by Attichitcuk's [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|encountered]] and destroyed a group of [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], which illegally sought to take control of the moon.<ref name="GB" />

To prepare for further [[Alaris Prime colonial war|conflict]] with the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], Attichitcuk undertook a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission along with two other Wookiees to uncover the extent of their enemy's activities. Meanwhile, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], a representative of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who served as a guide to the colonists, had Chewbacca work on training [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] at a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]].<ref name="GB" />

===A chieftain in need===
{{Quote|Attichitcuk has been shot down! But wait, I sense the spark of life in him still.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=HeLives.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Itchy-ambush.png|thumb|right|200px|The ambush of Attichitcuk]]
Having found several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the area, all under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[DRN-38]], Attichitcuk headed for the base, but he was stopped in his path by another group of droids, who [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|demanded his surrender]]. When the chieftain refused, the droids killed his companions, wounding Attichitcuk and leaving him for [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="GB" />

Through use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Jinn [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] that Attichitcuk survived his injuries. Jinn encouraged Chewbacca to stay calm, and he advised the Wookiees to train more warriors and to construct a [[Unidentified Wookiee medical droid|medical droid]].<ref name="GB" /> Once ten<ref name="Prima" /> bowcaster troopers were suitably prepared, Jinn instructed Chewbacca, who wielded his own bowcaster, to assemble his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] at a set of [[marker]]s at the edge of the base, launching the rescue mission from there.<ref name="GB" /> Meanwhile, more troopers were being trained at the base in order to keep it defended.<ref name="Prima" />

==The rescue==
{{Quote|You're approaching Trade Federation territory now. Stick together and expect an attack at any time.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=AllInThisTogether.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
While Jinn instructed the eleven Wookiees<ref name="Prima" /> to stay close and anticipate danger, the party moved northwest, coming to the ford of a [[Water/Legends|river]], where three [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]]-wielding Battle Droid Beta Versions were stationed. The Wookiees destroyed the droids but sustained injuries in the fight. On Jinn's advice, the party stopped to heal with the help of the medical droid before venturing onward.<ref name="GB" />

The Wookiees defeated four more droids on the other side of the river and eventually found Attichitcuk lying wounded on the ground. The [[Wookiee medical droid]] healed the chieftain to the point that he could make the trip to safety with Chewbacca's party.<ref name="GB" /> In the meantime, a fresh squad of at least two bowcaster troopers departed from the base, following the direction of the first party and intending to reinforce that group.<ref name="Prima" />

[[File:Revenge_at_base.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Droidekas attacking the Wookiee base]]
As Chewbacca's party headed back to the base, a group of six Battle Droid Beta Versions engaged them on the southern side of the river, but the arrival of the Wookiee reinforcements resulted in a swift destruction of the droids.<ref name="Prima" /> After the Wookiees returned to the base, Jinn recommended that Attichitcuk enter the base's [[command center]] for protection, sensing that another attack was coming. Three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], a stronger type of battle droid, were sent by DRN-38 to attack the base, but that attack was also repelled by Chewbacca and the Wookiees.<ref name="GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Battlefield promotions are not easy to deal with, but Chewbacca handles the leadership role with a skill not often seen.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=KingChewie.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Safely recovering from his injuries, Attichitcuk stepped down as the leader of the colonists, with Chewbacca taking his place. With Jinn's help, the Wookiees orchestrated two attacks: [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|one]] on a Trade Federation [[Trade Federation outpost|outpost]] and [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|another]] on a [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]]. Attichitcuk had fully recovered by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the climactic [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], in which the Trade Federation was driven off the moon.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Attichitcuk has been killed! Our efforts have been in vain!|Qui-Gon Jinn if the player loses Attichitcuk, failing the mission|audio=AttichitcukDeath.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The rescue of Attichitcuk was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> It features an the fourth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, entitled "Researching Technology," where the player is tasked with saving Attichitcuk in order to complete the level. The player has control over how many troopers to send into the battle and will lose immediately if either Chewbacca or Attichitcuk are killed.<ref name="GB" />

The appearance of the droidekas in the level is a scripted event, only occurring after Attichitcuk has been garrisoned. A minor discrepancy exists between the accompanying strategy and the game itself, with the strategy guide stating that five battle droids are present on the other side of the river when the player first crosses it,<ref name="Prima" /> while only four are present in the game.<ref name="GB" /> This article treats the game as the correct version of events.
